candidate_windows.window_text: For all experiments, we set the temperature to 0 and top_p to 1.0 to ensure deterministic outputs. For Qwen models, we applied YaRN (Peng et al., 2024) position embeddings with a scaling factor of 4 and original maximum position embeddings of 131,072 tokens, following the recommended configuration for extended context processing.
